name: Ingestion Issue
description: Represents a task for ingesting and preprocessing a single document or code file for RAG purposes.
descricao: Represents a task for ingesting and preprocessing a single document or code file for RAG purposes.

properties.name: file_path
properties.description: Absolute path or URL to the file to be ingested.

properties.name: document_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for the document being ingested.

properties.name: content_hash
properties.description: SHA256 hash of the file content at time of ingestion.

properties.name: previous_cell_id
properties.description: ID of the previous cell being replaced (for 'update') or deleted (for 'delete').
